title: The AI Shift: The long-predicted decline in call centre jobs has finally begun
why_it_matters_hint: Headline says the long-predicted fall in call centre jobs has begun.
notes: FT page returns an access error (403/paywall); no other outlet found carrying this FT column. Revelio Labs published related data (global call centre headcount 5.3% below its Dec 2023 peak) but it is not confirmed to be the FT's source, so it is not used in the entry.
